capabilities: Sync saved Readplace articles into the vault as one Markdown note each
Write properties, the AI summary and full article text into each note
Run scheduled syncs every 60 minutes plus manual Sync now and Refresh all notes commands
Sign in to and out of a Readplace account from the plugin settings
Detect edited or renamed notes via a SHA-256 hash before each write
disambiguation: Not a read-later client or reader; it only copies Readplace articles into the vault, and edits never flow back to Readplace.
extras: Free plugin, but the required Readplace account has a 14-day trial then needs a subscription; a lapsed account still syncs read-only. The README documents limitations (no highlights, no tags or author, never deletes notes) and an iOS sign-in bug that was fixed; requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ on desktop or mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull articles saved in a Readplace read-later account into the vault as notes.

relations.evidence: Copies the articles you've saved in Readplace into your vault as Markdown notes.

summary: Syncs articles saved in Readplace into the vault as Markdown notes with properties, the AI summary, reading status and full text.
